**Finding: MISSING (critical) — no limitation of liability in the Agreement.**

Investigation summary:
- **Full-text scan** for "liability", "damages", "consequential", "aggregate", "exceed", "no event", "limitation" returned no cap or damages-exclusion language. The only hits on "liability" (Section 10.2, p0061–p0062) are no-joint-venture/agency disclaimers.
- **Section 9 (Warranties)** contains only entity/authority representations plus a Globix carve-out — no liability language hidden there.
- **Section 10 (General Provisions)** runs notices → headings with no cap; there is **no indemnity clause** at all.
- **Fee basis check:** Section 3.1 — the Company pays HDI 30% of Net Sales above $11,000/month, so "fees paid or payable by the Company" is a real, non-illusory cap base (and Section 2 contemplates a Termination Payment tied to twelve months' Net Sales).

Both Parties are exposed to unlimited direct and consequential damages, so the preferred position is proposed rather than a fallback.

Redline (validated `ok:true`) — new **Section 10.9** inserted after 10.8, which survives for two years under the existing Section 10.7 survival clause:
- Mutual exclusion of indirect/consequential/punitive damages and lost profits;
- Mutual cap at the **greater of twelve months' fees payable by the Company and USD 1,000,000**;
- **Uncapped Excluded Claims**: confidentiality, data protection/security, indemnification, gross negligence, wilful misconduct, fraud, and infringement of the other Party's IP;
- The Company's Section 3 payments and any Termination Payment are expressly **not "damages"** for cap purposes, so the cap cannot be used to erode HDI's payment entitlement or ours.

Placement in General Provisions (rather than a new numbered section after Warranties) avoids renumbering Section 10 and keeps the edit minimal.
